messages:
AlertBot: 🚨 Detected spike: hosted-api-gateway (prod-us-west-2) 504 rate jumped to ~11.8% over last 5m. Creating incident channel and tagging oncall.
Jules (oncall): I'm in. grabbing initial graphs + traces. Can someone post any customer P0s?
Olga (prod-support): Priya flagged a customer repro (ACME) getting timeouts since ~08:02 UTC, ticket #5239. They've hit multiple 504s.
Kai - eng-sre: I'm seeing repeated 504s from gateway -> auth-proxy upstream. Latency for token validation spiked to 3s then 10s, then gateway times out at 10s.
Maya R (infra): Noted. Recent deploy of auth-proxy config at ~07:55 UTC? DeployBot: `deploy/auth-proxy/2026-03-12-07:55` succeeded.
DeployBot: deployment auth-proxy v2.14.1 rolled to prod-us-west-2 at 07:55 by sahil-ci. No automated rollbacks.
Jules (oncall): timeline matches. Let's capture quick logs. Kai, can you pull 504 traces and headers for a sample request?
Kai - eng-sre: Pasting filtered logs (redacted keys):
```
[2026-03-12T07:59:12Z] gateway: upstream_status=504 upstream=auth-proxy-2 host=api.redwood.internal path=/v1/generate latency=10.02s
[2026-03-12T07:59:13Z] auth-proxy: token_validation_ms=10005 db_call=9ms err="timeout validating token"
[2026-03-12T08:00:01Z] gateway: client=ACME corp-client-id req_id=abcd1234 status=504
```
Jules (oncall): Looks like token validation RPCs are timing out at 10s, matching gateway timeout. Could be a client-side blocking call to KMS or external auth DB.
Olga (prod-support): Customer reports 504s even for small payloads (single prompt). No pattern by model size.
Priya (customer-success): ACME attached curl repro: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` -> 504 consistently 08:00-08:07 UTC.
Maya R (infra): Checking KMS and keys. Nothing flagged in cloud KMS console, but we're seeing elevated 5xx from auth-proxy pool.
Kai - eng-sre: Running `kubectl -n hosted logs auth-proxy-2 --since=15m` shows repeated `context deadline exceeded` when calling `authdb` service.
Jules (oncall): Quick mitigations: 1) increase auth-proxy replicas, 2) raise gateway upstream timeout to 15s temporarily, 3) enable circuit-breaker to failfast auth checks for low-risk clients. Thoughts?
Sahil K (platform): Will scale auth-proxy to +3 replicas now. Also can spin a fallback path that uses cached token validation for recently seen tokens.
Maya R (infra): I'm bumping replicas: `kubectl scale deploy/auth-proxy --replicas=6 -n hosted`. Doing it now.
Kai - eng-sre: Scaling observed, new pods ready at ~08:07 UTC.
Olga (prod-support): ACME confirms partial recoveries around 08:08 but still intermittent 504s for some requests.
Jules (oncall): I want to avoid raising gateway timeouts unless necessary — that just hides downstream slowness. But for critical customers we can extend to 15s for 10 min. Anyone to run feature flag to increase gateway timeout for prod-us-west-2?
Sahil K (platform): I'm toggling the timeout override: `PATCH /config/gateway/timeouts { region: "us-west-2", timeout_ms: 15000 }` -> applied at 08:09 UTC.
DeployBot: config-change gateway/timeouts applied by sahil-ci at 08:09:12 UTC.
Jules (oncall): After scaling+timeout, overall 504 rate dropped to 3% by 08:12. Still seeing auth-proxy 10s tails. Need root cause.
Kai - eng-sre: Traces show a subset of auth-proxy instances had a regression in authdb client that caused connection pool exhaustion after the v2.14.1 deploy. The stack shows missing connection close in `authdb.Client.GetToken()` in commit `a7b3f2`.
Maya R (infra): Confirmed: memory and open fd counts on older pods rose prior to failures. New pods initially better, but then some pods also show leak.
Olga (prod-support): Customer impact: multiple customers (ACME, BetaCorp) reported errors between 07:59-08:15. Logged as SEV3 for cohort; raising to SEV2 due to revenue impact.
Priya (customer-success): ACME wants an ETA and mitigation steps. Communicating that we're rolling back / hotfixing.
Jules (oncall): Next steps: Kai to prepare hotfix revert of client change; Sahil to keep replicas and timeout override; Maya to scrub KMS/DB latency but looks authdb client bug; Olga/Priya to communicate to customers.
Kai - eng-sre: I'll cut a rollback PR to revert `a7b3f2` and push a hotfix image `auth-proxy:v2.14.2-hotfix` with explicit connection close. ETA 30-45m.
Sahil K (platform): I'll keep autoscaler override for auth-proxy to min 4 replicas for 2h. Also enabling request caching for token validation for 60s TTL as a temporary guard.
Jules (oncall): Assigning action owners in thread for postmortem: Kai (cause & fix), Maya (infra metrics & remediation), Sahil (deploy/config policy + autoscaler changes), Olga (customer comms), Priya (customer followups).
Olga (prod-support): Messaging draft -> "We're experiencing an authentication backend degradation causing intermittent 504s. We've applied mitigations (scaled service, temporary timeout bump) and are deploying a hotfix. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary." :thumbsup:
Priya (customer-success): Sent update to ACME at 08:25 UTC. They appreciate quick updates but need RCA.
DeployBot: new image auth-proxy:v2.14.2-hotfix deployed at 08:40 UTC to prod-us-west-2 by kai-ci.
Kai - eng-sre: Hotfix logs look good. Authdb calls now ~20-50ms, no `context deadline exceeded`. Monitoring 504s closely.
Jules (oncall): Gateway 504 rate back to baseline (~0.3%) at 08:46. Marking incident as mitigated.
Maya R (infra): Post-deploy metrics show fd usage normalized; no KMS errors. Looks like the leak fix addressed the tail.
Olga (prod-support): Customer ACME confirmed service returned green at ~08:50.
Jules (oncall): We're switching to postmortem mode. Action items recap (assign owners + due dates):
- Kai: Produce RCA draft (cause: authdb client connection close regression in commit a7b3f2) and code diff for hotfix. Due: 2026-03-14 EOD.
- Maya: Collect infra metrics (fd, mem, pod restarts, KMS traces) and snapshot dashboards. Due: 2026-03-13 noon.
- Sahil: Add autoscaler policy bump and temporary token-cache guard; propose safer rollout / canary for auth-proxy. Due: 2026-03-13 EOD.
- Olga & Priya: Prepare customer-facing postmortem summary and follow-ups for impacted accounts. Due: 2026-03-13 EOD.
- Jules: Schedule postmortem meeting and own follow-up. Due: 2026-03-14 EOD.
Jules (oncall): Any other lower-priority follow-ups? e.g., add unit test for connection close, add latency alerts for authdb >500ms, and limit gateway timeout hard cap.
Kai - eng-sre: Adding unit + integration test for authdb client connection lifecycle. Also propose new alert: auth-proxy token_validation P95 > 1s triggers paging.
Sahil K (platform): Will add canary rollout gate for auth-proxy config changes and require perf tests on token path.
Olga (prod-support): Filing internal incident ticket ENG-INC-2026-032 for tracking.
Priya (customer-success): Logging affected customers into the ticket for outreach: ACME, BetaCorp, DevShop.
Jules (oncall): Closing war room for now — incident mitigated. We'll keep this thread for postmortem work. :white_check_mark:
Sahil K (platform): Quick note: consider reducing gateway default upstream timeout from 10s -> 8s to detect regressions earlier; will propose in follow-up RFC.
Kai - eng-sre: Final note: root cause = regression in auth-proxy client (missing connection close) introduced in v2.14.1 commit a7b3f2; hotfix reverted and deployed as v2.14.2-hotfix.
Olga (prod-support): Thanks team. I'll mark communications done once postmortem summary is ready.
Jules (oncall): Thanks everyone. Postmortem meeting scheduled for 2026-03-14 16:00 UTC.
Priya (customer-success): ACME asked for a timeline on permanent fix — will loop in Kai and Sahil in follow-up.
Maya R (infra): FYI: no billing impact detected, just request failures. Will add retention of auth-proxy logs for 72h to help debug if needed.
Jules (oncall): End of thread.
